name: ratios
title: Ratios
description: The usual portfolio-evaluation ratios of the selected part next to the Portfolio's: Sharpe, Sortino, UPI, STARR, Calmar, Martin, Omega and Rachev, and the shape of the 12-week outcome (skew, kurtosis, odds of a loss). None of them is optimized; UPI is. Same held-out paths as every other figure.
